lines.text: There is no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus, because the law of the Spirit of life set them free.
God sent His own Son as an offering for sin, so the law's righteous standard would be fulfilled in us.
The mind of the flesh is death and is hostile to God, but the mind of the Spirit is wisdom and peace.
If the Spirit of God lives in you, the One who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will give life to your mortal bodies.
We received the Spirit of adoption and cry, "Abba! Father!", so we are children and priests of God.
